neighbours.label: inner pieces of multi-token brand and team names (P|amp|ers, Edmonton Oil Kings); weak
fire: We stocked up on Pampers and baby wipes before the long road trip.
Last night the Edmonton Oil Kings beat their rivals in overtime.
The nurse handed us a pack of Pampers for the newborn on the way out.
Fans of the Oil Kings packed the arena for the playoff opener.
A coupon for Pampers came in the mail along with the pharmacy flyer.
The young goalie signed with the Oil Kings after a strong junior season.
Grandma always bought Pampers because she trusted the brand.
Scouts flew in to watch the Oil Kings play their final home game.
quiet: We stocked up on diapers and baby wipes before the long road trip.
Last night the hometown team beat their rivals in overtime.
The nurse handed us a pack of diapers for the newborn on the way out.
Fans of the junior club packed the arena for the playoff opener.
A coupon for baby lotion came in the mail along with the pharmacy flyer.
The young goalie signed with a western club after a strong junior season.
Grandma always bought the store brand because she trusted it.
Scouts flew in to watch the local team play their final home game.

notes: Probe peaks only 0.15 (Pampers) and 0.18 (Oil Kings), Buffett 0.01-0.05. Expected to miss the median-fire bar; recorded as unclear.
